title: 第13章
content_zh:
汽车到处跑，公交里挤满了人。每天，城市醒得都早，炸油条的，蒸包子的，热气腾腾扑了顾客一脸，随后，骑自行车上班的人流往不同的方向去。
贺以诚带着展颜，到有外教的培训班补英语，外教是澳大利亚人，体味很重，他叫fill，展颜最开始不好意思张嘴说英文，上了两周的课，放开了些，但她那一嘴乡音是难改了。
他很忙，当年，辞职后先去的外企，做过市场部，干到项目经理。等下岗潮处露苗头时，他接手了一家建材企业，转制后，成为私企，贺以诚很快凭着天生的经商头脑，盘活了公司，九十年代后期，建材家居市场远不够规范，但贺以诚嗅到房改商机，九八年这年，公司尝试推出概念馆模式展示产品，一切刚起步，贺以诚常常顾不上吃饭。
“颜颜，我得出个短差，这几天的课让哥哥带着你去。”贺以诚要去北京考察，家中，林美娟又不在，他请贺图南的奶奶过来看顾孩子们几天。
展颜听贺以诚要出差，不懂那是什么，但他一走，她就得独自面对贺图南，她甚至有些希望培训班也有宿舍。
城里的一切都很稀奇，她觉得时间不够用，要学的太多了，所以，展颜每天下了培训班，回家也是在屋里学习，她用功的程度，令人咋舌。
贺图南觉得她对学习，有种饥饿感，同一屋檐下，他几乎看不到她出房间，但隔着门，隐约可以听到展颜读英语的声音。
他站门外听过几次，那发音，真够糟糕的，可她每天五点半准时起。贺图南班里有乡镇来的同学，他发现，展颜和他们很像，格外能吃苦。
“吃豆浆油条，还是包子米粥？”奶奶在晚上就要问第二天的早饭事宜，贺图南永远是随便，展颜见老人问得认真，觉得不选一个，太辜负她的心了，她说，“我想吃油条。”
“外头那个老油不知道炸了多少遍，不好，明儿我给你炸。”奶奶居然会炸油条。
展颜觉得奶奶很像王静的奶奶，可又不一样，她没有硬硬的发黑的指甲，胸前也没有脏兮兮的围裙，她有的是一头整齐的、花白的头发，真丝花纹短袖，笔直的长裤。
展颜说：“奶奶希望我们选一个，做饭的人，最不希望别人说随便了。”
过道的灯，幽昏不明，贺图南的声音也不够明朗，展颜沉默片刻，说：“我不是有意想使唤奶奶的。”
在乡下，打电话是奢侈的事情，展颜来之后，也只往家里打了两次电话，给孙晚秋打了一次。
她迟疑几秒，又问贺图南：“我看街上有电话亭，那里也能打电话？”
贺图南这才想起来，她问题很多，问人话时，有点懵懂，但又很专心，像请教不会的题目。
展颜问到这，不问了，她手里有钱，贺叔叔给的零花钱，平时花不着，她琢磨着以后买张电话卡去街上打，站那个小亭子里，又安静，又方便。
“谢谢你。”她每次道谢，都要加个“你”，让人觉得，心特别诚，“谢谢”说的煞有介事，贺图南想笑，他问她：
可现在贺以诚不在家，林美娟也不在，有些话，贺图南早想试探她了。
贺图南靠在墙上，头微仰着，眼睛再往下看她，成了狭长的一片阴影。

瞧这话问的，好像他跟贺叔叔没什么关系，展颜没回答，反倒问他：“贺叔叔不是你爸吗？”
content_en:
Cars were everywhere and buses were packed with people. Every day, the city wakes up early, frying fried dough sticks and steaming steamed buns, and the steam hits the faces of customers. Afterwards, people who ride bicycles to work flow in different directions.
He Yicheng took Zhanyan to a training class with a foreign teacher to improve his English. The foreign teacher was Australian and had a strong body odor. His name was fill. Zhanyan was embarrassed to open her mouth to speak English at first. After two weeks of classes, she became more relaxed, but her local accent was hard to change.
He was very busy. Back then, he worked in the marketing department and then as a project manager in the foreign company he first went to after resigning. When the wave of layoffs started to show, he took over a building materials company and converted it into a private enterprise. He Yicheng quickly used his natural business acumen to revitalize the company. In the late 1990s, the building materials and home furnishing market was far from standardized, but He Yicheng sensed business opportunities in housing reform. In 1998, the company tried to launch a concept museum model to display products. When everything was just getting started, He Yicheng often couldn't take care of eating.
"Yan Yan, I have a short errand. I asked my brother to take you to the classes these days." He Yicheng was going to Beijing for an inspection. Lin Meijuan was not at home, so he asked He Tunan's grandma to come over and take care of the children for a few days.
Zhanyan heard that He Yicheng was going on a business trip and didn't know what it was, but as soon as he left, she would have to face He Tunan alone. She even hoped that the training class would have dormitories.
Everything in the city was strange. She felt that there was not enough time and she had to learn too much. Therefore, Zhanyan finished the training class every day and studied in the house when she returned home. The extent of her study was astonishing.
He Tunan felt that she was hungry for learning. Under the same roof, he could hardly see her leave the room, but through the door, he could vaguely hear Zhan Yan's voice reading English.
He heard it several times while standing outside. The pronunciation was really bad, but she got up on time at half past five every day. There were classmates from the countryside in He Tunan's class, and he found that Zhanyan was very similar to them, and he was particularly able to endure hardships.
"Soy milk and fried dough sticks, or steamed buns and rice porridge?" Grandma would ask about the breakfast for the next day in the evening. He Tunan was always casual. Zhanyan saw the old man's serious question and felt that not choosing one would be a disappointment to her. She said, "I want to eat fried dough sticks."
"That old man outside has fried you dough sticks countless times. No, I'll fry them for you tomorrow." Grandma actually knows how to fry fried dough sticks.
Zhanyan felt that her grandma looked like Wang Jing's grandma, but she was different. She didn't have hard black nails or a dirty apron on her chest. She had neat, gray hair, silk patterned short sleeves, and straight trousers.
Zhanyan said: "Grandma wants us to choose one. The person who cooks the food, the last thing we want is to be told casually."
The lights in the corridor were dim and unclear, and He Tunan's voice was not clear enough. He Zhanyan was silent for a moment and said, "I didn't mean to manipulate grandma."
In the countryside, making phone calls was a luxury. After Zhanyan came, he only called home twice and once to Sun Wanqiu.
She hesitated for a few seconds and then asked He Tunan: "I see there is a phone booth on the street. Can you make calls there?"
He Tunan then remembered that she had a lot of questions. When asking people questions, she was a little confused, but very attentive, as if she was asking questions that she didn't know how to ask.
When Zhanyan asked this, she stopped asking. She had money in her hand and the pocket money given by Uncle He could not be spent normally. She thought about buying a phone card to make calls on the street. Standing in that small booth was quiet and convenient.
"Thank you." Every time she said thank you, she would add "you", which made people feel that she was very sincere and said "thank you" in a serious way. He Tunan wanted to laugh, so he asked her:
But now He Yicheng is not at home, and neither is Lin Meijuan. He Tunan has long wanted to test her.
He Tunan leaned against the wall, his head slightly raised, and his eyes looked down at her, forming a long and narrow shadow.
Judging from the question, it seemed that he had nothing to do with Uncle He. Zhanyan did not answer, but asked him: "Isn't Uncle He your father?"
